versions.subject: Update + New Rules
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: 'reg.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'reg.exe'
selection_delete:
    CommandLine|contains: ' delete '
selection_key:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\services\'
        - 'HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\services\'
condition: all of selection*
versions.spl: Image="*reg.exe" OR OriginalFileName="reg.exe" CommandLine="* delete *" CommandLine IN ("*HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\services\\*", "*HKLM\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\services\\*")
